lines.speaker: Spook
lines.text: Word's already going round about you. Girl who walked out of Camon's crew and into Kelsier's. That's a story people tell twice.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: I'd rather they didn't tell it at all.

lines.speaker: Spook
lines.text: Then don't get caught. That's the whole trick, isn't it?
